messages.text: What can I do to get a refund, then?

The order must first be delivered, and the shop must receive the cookware set back before a refund can be requested (refund-policy/v2/eligible-orders; refund-policy/v2/return). Once both are recorded, I can check whether a refund is allowed. If you’re looking to cancel or change delivery while it’s still on the way, that’s outside this process; I can connect you with a staff member.
